title: Default Servicing Note: Arrearage Kept Committed on a HECM Payment Release
content:
**Note.** Added to the amount kept committed in the payment release of a Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) loan moving onto the HECM Line of Credit, until the loan's property charge repayment record is closed, is the part of a property charge arrearage the repayment plan will not collect in the coming year. The record is the loan's Property Charge Advance Repayment record, a loan holding at most one open record.

**Tiers.**

1. Record in notice period, pending signature or defaulted, with an arrearage balance above 0.00: the whole arrearage balance.
2. Record active, with an arrearage balance above 0.00 and a monthly installment above 0.00: the arrearage balance less 12 monthly installments, never below 0.00.
3. Otherwise: 0.00.

**Hypothetical records.**

| Record | Arrearage balance | Monthly installment | Amount kept committed |
|---|---|---|---|
| defaulted | 6000.00 | any | 6000.00 |
| active | 6000.00 | 300.00 | 6000.00 less 3600.00, that is 2400.00 |
| active | 3000.00 | 300.00 | 3000.00 less 3600.00 is below 0.00, so 0.00 |
| active | 3000.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 |
| closed, or none | any | any | 0.00 |
